🔒 Your Privacy & Your Rights

What we collect: Your name, phone number, Instagram handle, birthday, and anniversary (optional) for the sole purpose of operating the LVR Rewards Program.

We never sell your data. Your information is never sold, rented, or shared with third parties for advertising or marketing purposes.

SMS communications: By joining, you consent to receive no more than 1 promotional or transactional text message per week from Las Vegas Restaurants. Standard message and data rates from your carrier may apply. You may opt out at any time by replying STOP to any message. This program complies with the Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA).

Data storage: Your data is stored securely on Google Firebase infrastructure. You may request full deletion of your account data at any time by contacting @las_vegas_restaurants on Instagram.

No purchase required. Joining the LVR Rewards Program is free and no purchase is necessary to participate.
